horoscopes.horoscope: Now at last you have realised that you have been preoccupied with work at the cost of your family life. Making up to them now is going to take a lot more effort. Ganesha says be ready to open your purse strings for either eating out, going out for a movie or shopping at the best places. You will turn romantic and tend to mingle with your lover at any cost. You will not only impress your lover with sweet words but also try to sweeten your relationship. Spending wonderful time at an exotic restaurant or poolside lounge will bring your lover closer to you. Your better focus in what you want to do and patience will help you deal with all the matters more easily. Your happiness will be high and physical health will remain good. Its the best time to start Yoga or Gym. You will now be thinking more seriously about financial planning and long term security. As desire to have more stable financial graph increases today, as you pay more attention to expenses. A wonderful day to explore new opportunities. An exciting project is likely to come to you today and Ganesha advises you to accept it as you may face no hassles in completing it. You will double your energy to finish it off, says Ganesha.

You are likely to turn excessively self centred today, says Ganesha. This could cause you to be very insecure. You will have a tendency to control and dominate others. There is all likelihood that you will thereby jeopardize important relationships. You are advised to be sensitive to the needs and feelings of all those you come across. Do not allow your selfishness to get the better of you and lead you to alienate those who matter. You will get imaginative and apply out-of-the-box approaches to cheer up your darling. If your loved one may be mentally broken or indifferent to you, Backstreet Boys’ “Show me the meaning of being lonely” will get him/her closer to you and spend a splendid evening, advises Ganesha. The time is right to involve yourself in body building. Challenge your own limits in exercise. You can spend more time at gym, yoga and aerobics. Today you will realise the value of good health and work on those lines, feels Ganesha. You may wish to buy new ornaments or jewelry today. You will be willing to present yourself as more attractive person in front of others, thus you may wish to buy clothes that look more expensive. This is the perfect day to hammer out technical solutions at the workplace. Being rigid is not the right way to deal with different issues. You have to open up to face every challenge coming your way. Be more flexible, suggests Ganesha.

Ganesha opines that today you might feel a little blue and under the weather. You may harbour feelings of loneliness today. Your repressed emotions and yearnings as well as your intellectual leanings will likely come to the fore today, says Ganesha. You may find your partner indifferent to your views. Once you see that you are not able to convince your partner, you tend to try to cast a spell on him/her. Be careful as your loved one wants to see the natural you, says Ganesha. Today you should practice right ‘investment of energy’. This means you should work on things only if they are going to yield results. You may also talk to people for long hours, with no apparent outcome. The time is good for wooing your partner. You shall be a bit careless about finances today. You may end up paying too much for something that you need to buy immediately. You should do proper market research before buying anything, advises Ganesha. Your hard work seems to go in vein today. You will try to influence people through your moral values. Channelize your energy to a right direction, advises Ganesha. Be careful of your colleagues who may try to tarnish your image, suggests Ganesha.

Your ideas today are source of your energy.A situation may arise, which will force you to take hard decisions later. A new business or venture may prove beneficial. Your magical touch will bestow success in every endeavour. Ganesha is with you. You are likely to express your ambition to your lover. Your sweetheart will appreciate your future plans and will feel very happy and satisfied. With your powers to express reaching new highs, you will reach the pinnacle of harmony in your love life. You could make new friends as your aura would be positive today. These friends could be of help to you in one way or the other. Besides, you will be able to stay committed to your friends and work. Any appreciation will boost your morale. This is going to be a normal day for money matters wherein financial gains aren’t very evident, unless you put in efforts. In other words, stroke of luck in regard to money matters is not foreseen. It’s a lucky day in the office. Expect that big pat for the dedication and hard work you have put forward. You may also fetch a reward from your colleagues or boss, feels Ganesha. You will be happy feeling that people around you are really nice to work with.

Agreed that home is where the heart is. But today, your home is where your troubles will be. The faster you try to run away from them, the quicker they seem to catch up with you, says Ganesha. So, scooting off may not be the best solution. Some people around you may try to blow things out of proportion; the best way to keep them in check is with a smile. For, a smile is the secret weapon of all winners, reminds Ganesha. Listen to the heart of your loved one. You may make some important changes to your lifestyle. Devote some time to your loved one as well. You may ask them about matters close to their hearts. You will enjoy good health and mood. You will be positive and confident. You will also be more focussed. You will be able to accomplish several tasks efficiently . However, you should work with proper planning and avoid the ‘trial and error’ technique. Ganesha suggests you to be extra careful while lending money, as recovery may take more time than expected. Today you can start something of your own which later may prove to be financially gainful. Ganesha foresees a great day for you. With the superb energy levels, you experience today, you will be executing your tasks to the best of your ability. It’s simply not fair to get too busy thinking about career, feels Ganesha.

Today might just bring those emotions to the fore that were lying in the closet of your heart. You will develop a bonding – a sentimental attachment – with your belongings. But you’ll be a fish out of water, if and when you don’t find the surroundings to your liking. You may think of expressing your love by gifting something precious to the one who makes your heart beat faster. Know what your sweetheart really loves and takes care of. Be responsible for your lover if you want to make a long-term commitment, suggests Ganesha. Look forward to get desired results for your efforts, as lady luck is smiling on you today. Your mood shall take an upward swing and health will remain fine. Both official and pleasure trips, will be enjoyable as well as fruitful. Today fortune will favour you n financial matters. Your positive approach towards expenses will help you take right decisions. You will be research well buying or selling anything. You will depend on luck since others may not be able to recognise the efforts you are putting in to finish your tasks. Ganesha says not to rely on luck since karma defines your destiny. You will definitely yield positive results in the long run if you believe yourself, inspires Ganesha.

Some days are full of new ideas. Today is one such day as you radiate diligence and intelligence. Consider it an auspicious moment to begin new business schemes, especially if you happen to be self-employed. Today, you will be able to think at a level higher and clearer than the rest. But, as happens when you focus more on work, it comes at the cost of family time. Maintain a balance, advises Ganesha. You may prefer to enjoy a hush-hush evening with your soul mate at the end of a stressful day. You are in a mood of being sweet and naughty with your lover. Make it a fantastic, cheerful and unforgettable experience, suggests Ganesha. See to it that you don’t waste energy unnecessarily today. Avoid physically exhaustive tasks. You should not just avoid wasting energy but even try to accumulate it. For this you should eat health foods with protein, vitamins and avoid junk foods. You will not be able to find any logic behind your current financial status and will be wondering how to progress financially. Ganesha feels that this is the time to cut back, relax and enjoy what you have. An action-packed day will keep you on your toes. You will be at your energetic best. You will be engaged in organizing conferences or meetings. At the end of the day, you may gain satisfaction from your work.

Dig in deep and keep yourself in the hunt, says Ganesha. Karma matters, but don’t give much thought to the outcome. In matters of joint ventures, adopt a wait-and-watch approach today. You will only invite more love if you are slightly more compromising in your personal relationship. You have to sacrifice, says Ganesha. Being loyal and committed in love will bring your partner closer to you. Today what others tell you about you will matter a lot. Criticism can make you feel low and down. But, criticizing others can also impact your energy in adverse manner. Don’t get jealous with others, be happy with what you have. This is a good day to arrange a get-together and spend a sum on big party. This is also a favourable day to invest some money on informal business parties or meetings. Ganesha foresees an average day for you. The pressure at the workplace will coerce you to focus completely on the tasks in hand. Your analytical abilities should help you finish projects with ease.

The nerd in you will rise to the fore today. Religious literature will catch your fancy. Ganesha also sees you diving deep into pages of detective tomes, murder and science fiction. Au contraire, find some relief from the roller-coaster by listening to some soothing music. You are honest but you need to be responsive to your sentimental partner. Your loved one may demand you to be mature. You need to be realistic and practical enough to understand your partner’s needs, says Ganesha. Your day is good today. You won’t sit idle, feels Ganesha. Besides, you will also plan your work and day properly. However, you should not push yourself much because the day is average from the perspective of health. Relaxing also is important. If you want to work on your finances, Ganesha feels that you need to review your balance-sheet objectively; you will know where you have gone wrong and be able to rectify your mistakes. You will give and get appreciation from colleagues, boss or senior authorities. However, they may disagree with you. Ganesha feels that you need to accept some criticism in order to improve. You may have to challenge yourself to get back to the energetic spirit.

Good news for students! If you have been trying your luck for studies abroad, today is an opportune day, says Ganesha. Also, get your priorities straight and see that you achieve them one by one, for only a well-planned move can take you a step closer to your ambition. Those engaged in stock exchange and dealing with shares can expect a fruitful day ahead. Your sympathetic responses will urge your beloved to speak his or her heart out. You will feel comfortable in the company of your loved one. Talk about the matters that boost the emotional responses, says Ganesha. You want to be forever with your sweetheart. You will be in good health today. It’s a good time to do sports activities that you like. You will have many things and many reasons to be happy about. Someone’s love and care will boost your energy level, feels Ganesha. Today is a favourable day to think about some long term investments, however, stars are not in favor of you investing in property. Money may be spent behind leisure activities. A fantastic day comes your way. Projects will be happening smoothly. New opportunities will broaden your responsibilities. Discussions on important issues at the office must be rescheduled. Enjoy the company of a new member of your team.

Bursting with new ideas, you want to make the world a better place! You will give your best in a team and will come up with great schemes and solutions. At gatherings, says Ganesha, you Bulls remain your charming self. You tend to hurt your lover’s feelings as you are quite flamboyant. You need to be alert and be sensitive to your lover’s needs and demands. You need some time out to re-think and take the right steps, suggests Ganesha. For quite some time, you have taxed yourself enough due to various tasks so now is the time to give yourself enough rest. This is an ideal day to call your friends at home rather than going out and meeting them. Today you can buy artifacts to beautify your home. You can arrange movie show at home with near ones and dear ones or can plan to invite some friends/relatives for lunch or dinner. A day demanding you to be extra alert, warns Ganesha. Be careful while performing technical work. It is a day to rectify or sort out issues related to systems and software. The interruption is not likely to cause any delays as you will work smoothly, says Ganesha.

Home is where the hearth is, in which the troubles you need to deal with today are smouldering. Running away from your problems will simply have you out of breath; it would be wiser to take a stand and find solutions to petty conflicts without losing your perspective. Make no mountains out of mole hills, says Ganesha. If you wish to propose to someone, Ganesha says today’s the day! Go down on your knee and gift the thing that immediately captures his or her attention. Go to the place that perfectly defines the state of peaceful mind, suggests Ganesha. This is an ideal time to take a call on matters related to money or take any decision that requires more logical thinking. This is best day to find solution to things that puzzle you. It is a balanced day from the health and mood point of view. Any investment behind project or assignment would be worth it. Your creativity would be at peak and you will be good with words so it’s the best time to create something that can help earn good money. A good day personally, but not so much on the professional side. You may not succeed in finding permanent solutions to problems. Some technical issue may keep you worried. Prioritize your work and addressing the issues will smooth your work, feels Ganesha.
